--- title: "[StepImputeMedian]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Impute missing numeric values with the column median. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/step_impute_median.py#L114-L233){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python StepImputeMedian(columns, id=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Each selected numeric column has its nulls filled in place with that column's median. A column that is entirely null at fit time has no median to impute with; it is left unchanged (not dropped) with a warning, and passes through ``transform`` untouched. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [columns]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Selector]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Columns to impute. Accepts a single column name, a list of names, a shoez selector such as ``Selectors.numeric_predictors()`` (see `Selectors` for the full set), or a narwhals or polars selector (``narwhals.selectors.numeric()``, ``polars.selectors.numeric()``). Selectors are resolved against the frame's schema when the recipe is fitted, so the same selector works on any backend. Only numeric columns are meaningful here. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Stable step identifier. Default ``"impute_median"``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The null is filled in place with the column median of the observed values: ::: {#8368aa3a .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1.0, 2.0, None, 4.0]}) df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
x
0 1.0
1 2.0
2 NaN
3 4.0
``` ::: ::: Specifying the step touches no data: ::: {#071d9a9f .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add(StepImputeMedian(s.numeric_predictors())) recipe ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Recipe (untrained) Inputs: no roles assigned Steps: step_impute_median(select(role='predictor', type=NumericType)) [untrained] ``` ::: ::: `fit()` computes the median of the observed values: ::: {#332957c3 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Recipe (trained) Inputs: 1 columns — 1 predictor Steps: step_impute_median(x) [trained] ``` ::: ::: `transform()` fills the nulls in place: ::: {#dc142a95 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
x
0 1.0
1 2.0
2 2.0
3 4.0
``` ::: :::
